title: National Core Arts Standards: Music

author.literal: National Coalition for Core Arts Standards

note: Four artistic processes: Creating, Performing, Responding, Connecting; eleven anchor standards

title: Programme de formation de l'école québécoise: domaine des arts
note: Trois compétences: Inventer, Interpréter, Apprécier. Apprécier porte explicitement une dimension socioculturelle

title: Model Music Curriculum: Key Stages 1 to 3
note: Non-statutory; reopened the argument about whose repertoire counts

title: The AEC/Polifonia Learning Outcomes for the 1st, 2nd and 3rd Cycles in Music
note: Practical / theoretical / generic. Treats improvisation as both skill and knowledge; 3rd cycle asks graduates to question conventions

title: The Musicality of Non-Musicians: An Index for Assessing Musical Sophistication in the General Population
note: Five subscales. NB: the construct name ranks people; see README on the sophistication problem

title: Entwicklung und Validierung eines Kompetenzmodells im Fach Musik: Wahrnehmen und Kontextualisieren von Musik
note: Binds perceiving and contextualising as ONE competence. The closest formal statement of the MTILT position

title: A Basis for Music Education
note: C(L)A(S)P. Composition, Audition and Performance direct; Literature and Skill acquisition supporting

title: Music Matters: A New Philosophy of Music Education
note: Praxial philosophy; musicianship as procedural knowledge; musicing

title: Musicking: The Meanings of Performing and Listening
note: Cited in Enkerli 2019. Resists competency framing by construction

title: Music, Informal Learning and the School: A New Classroom Pedagogy
note: Five principles: learner-chosen music, learning by ear, peer groups, haphazard progression, integrated skills. Basis of Musical Futures

title: Community Music: In Theory and in Practice
note: Hospitality as method; principled refusal to pre-specify outcomes

title: Self-Determined Learning: Heutagogy in Action
note: Capability rather than competency; double-loop learning; learner-defined pathways

title: Ungrading: Why Rating Students Undermines Learning (and What to Do Instead)
Reference Framework of Competences for Democratic Culture
note: 20 competences across values, attitudes, skills, knowledge. Includes tolerance of ambiguity and listening/observing. Written for the LEARNER, unlike most cultural competence work

title: Culturally Responsive Teaching in Music Education: From Understanding to Application
note: Specifies the TEACHER's competence, not the learner's

title: Identification and Assessment of Intercultural Competence as a Student Outcome of Internationalization
container-title: Journal of Studies in International Education

title: AMTA Professional Competencies
note: Where "singing as breathing exercise" actually lives, framed clinically

title: Music Education for Some: Music Standards at the Nexus of Neoliberal Reforms and Neoconservative Values
container-title: Action, Criticism, and Theory for Music Education

title: Bruits: Essai sur l'économie politique de la musique
note: Cited in Enkerli 2019. The commodification aim lives here, not in music education

title: Prescriptive and Descriptive Music-Writing
note: The sharpest single cut in the representation literature, and it comes from ethnomusicology

title: A Framework for the Evaluation of Music Representation Systems
note: Expressive completeness vs structural generality. Reissued in Contemporary Music Review as "Surveying Musical Representation Systems"

title: Beyond MIDI: The Handbook of Musical Codes
TENOR: International Conference on Technologies for Music Notation and Representation
note: Running since 2015. Open proceedings. An entire venue for the representation question

title: The Notation of Sound for Composition and Transcription
container-title: Proceedings of the International Conference on Technologies for Music Notation and Representation (TENOR)

title: Spectromorphological Analysis of Sound Objects: An Adaptation of Pierre Schaeffer's Typomorphology
note: Schaeffer's ~28 categories reduced to 15 with a working symbol set

title: Traité des objets musicaux
The Geometry of Musical Rhythm
note: Rhythm necklaces; Euclidean rhythms. Underpins the ring representations in the suite

title: From Xenakis's UPIC to Graphic Notation Today
note: Open access. UPIC is DrawnQurve's ancestor

title: The Semantics of Timbre
note: Three recurring dimensions: brightness (spectral centroid), texture/roughness (AM in critical bands), fullness (fundamental strength, inharmonicity). Cross-linguistically stable

title: Semantic Crosstalk in Timbre Perception
Timbre Trait Analysis: The Semantics of Instrumentation
Designing Sound
note: Cited in Enkerli 2019. Source of the scepticism about unstable descriptors

title: Ear Cleaning: Notes for an Experimental Music Course
A Sound Education: 100 Exercises in Listening and Sound-Making
note: The practical companion. Starts from sounds learners already encounter

title: Deep Listening: A Composer's Sound Practice
note: "A way of listening in every possible way to everything possible." Hearing is involuntary; listening is voluntary. Candidate remedy for the over-analysis ditch

title: Flow: The Psychology of Optimal Experience
note: Challenge-skill balance: anxiety when challenge exceeds skill, boredom when skill exceeds challenge. The canonical model for the desire/skill gap

title: Son propre son: bricolage sonore et appropriation technologique
note: Appropriation as the operative concept. Applies to frameworks as readily as to technology

title: Homo Ludens: Proeve eener bepaling van het spel-element der cultuur
note: Cited in Enkerli 2019. Play as culture-generating and serious; Caillois wrote partly in response

title: Les jeux et les hommes: le masque et le vertige
note: Agon, alea, mimicry, ilinx; and the paidia-ludus continuum. Paidia is free improvised play, ludus is play bound by convention and arbitrary difficulty. Gamification imports ludus and loses paidia

title: The Great Good Place: Cafes, Coffee Shops, Community Centers, Beauty Parlors, General Stores, Bars, Hangouts, and How They Get You Through the Day
note: The third place: neither home nor work, low barrier to entry, conversation as main activity, regulars, playful mood. Close to a definition of "being a good hang"

title: Self-Compassion: The Proven Power of Being Kind to Yourself
note: Self-kindness, common humanity, mindfulness. Common humanity is the active ingredient for the desire/skill ditch: a difficulty named as shared rather than personal

title: Musical Gestures: Sound, Movement, and Meaning
note: The embodiment crossing. Connects to DrawnQurve and to the breath material

title: Formalized Music: Thought and Mathematics in Composition
note: Xenakis trained and worked as an architect with Le Corbusier. The Philips Pavilion (Brussels, 1958) and Metastaseis share a generating idea: string glissandi and ruled surfaces are the same geometry, built twice. The cleanest case of a crossing that is one object rather than an illustration

title: Talking About Music Is Like Dancing About Architecture
note: Cited in Enkerli 2019. The catalogue of attributions — Martin Mull, Elvis Costello, Steve Martin, Laurie Anderson, Zappa, Monk — and the source of the TaMilDaA acronym. Unresolved attribution is part of how the put-down works

title: NIME: International Conference on New Interfaces for Musical Expression
note: Running since 2001, open proceedings. Where instrument design is treated as a research question. Relevant to the law of the instrument: a hex grid is a different hammer, not an absence of one

title: The Conduct of Inquiry: Methodology for Behavioral Science
note: The law of the instrument: "Give a small boy a hammer and he will find that everything he encounters needs pounding." Later Maslow 1966. The Golden Hammer anti-pattern

title: Computational Ethnomusicology: Perspectives and Challenges
note: Editorial for a special issue. Names MIR's own default in its first sentence: models and technologies developed for mainstream popular music in the so-called Western tradition

title: Investigating q\textschwañ\textschwat in Amhara Secular Music: An Acoustic and Historical Study
note: Audits a musicological consensus standing since the 1960s against acoustic measurement. A worked model of what a checkable claim about a modal system looks like

title: Theory of African Music, Volume II
note: Volume I first published 1994 by F. Noetzel. The theory from inside the scholarship of the music, against which TUBS and Toussaint's geometry are outsiders' instruments

title: Timing and Meter in Mande Drumming from Mali
note: Over 20,000 stroke onsets. The beat is near-perfectly isochronous; the subdivision is not — kengebu averages 41:31:28, Bire's bell 59:41. Categorical Long/Short distinctions are discrete metrical categories, not deviations. Grid-based transcription imposes artificial regularity

title: Beyond Symbols: Indexical Notation for Sound Morphology
note: Peircean indexical notation: causal relation between performer and visual response, without iconic resemblance. The score Undersong responds in real time to spectral flux and noise content. A timbre notation with no symbol set to learn — which answers the objection recorded against Thoresen and Skold

title: Beyond a Western Center of Music Information Retrieval: A Bibliometric Analysis of the First 25 Years of ISMIR Authorship
container-title: Transactions of the International Society for Music Information Retrieval
note: The map of who does MIR and where, over 25 years. Effectively the "music labs around the world" list, already assembled

title: Tensions, Issues and Strengths of Professor Lucy Green's Model of Informal Learning
note: The critical companion the green2008informal entry said was missing. Read before adopting the model's posture

title: Participatory Discrepancies and the Power of Music
note: "The power of music is in its participatory discrepancies, and these are basically of two kinds: processual and textural." Processual is timing; textural is pitch and timbre, including paired instruments producing blended harmonics. They work outside conscious rational analysis; notation preserves only a "petrified skeleton"

title: Music Grooves: Essays and Dialogues
note: Already cited in Enkerli 2019 for the Feld half. The Keil half is where participatory discrepancies get developed at length

title: Free Play: Improvisation in Life and Art
note: The disposition underneath discrepancy: someone has to be willing not to be exact

title: The Improvisational State of Mind: A Multidisciplinary Study of an Improvisatory Approach to Classical Music Repertoire Performance
Are Classical Musicians Excluded from Improvisation? Cultural Hegemony and the Effects of Ideology on Musicians' Attitudes Towards Improvisation
note: The ideology half of why the training removes permission

title: Rhythm Circle / Mathémusique
note: Postdoc, Université de Strasbourg; PhD Ircam/Sorbonne; editorial board, Journal of Mathematics and Music. Geometry of musical rhythms, with an outreach channel and the interactive rhythm-circle.com. A working public tool closest to the suite's ring representations — and the clearest case of a representation that cannot show a participatory discrepancy

title: Commonality and Variation in Mental Representations of Music Revealed by a Cross-Cultural Comparison of Rhythm Priors in 15 Countries
note: Fifteen countries. The empirical version of the question the Barlow / anti-Barlow scenario asks in a room

title: Anti-Colonial Strategies in Cross-cultural Music Science Research
note: Strategies rather than critique. Pairs with the ISMIR bibliometrics for the "music labs around the world" thread
